lint.command: bun run lint:check && bun run format:check

branchName.instructions: Use `<type>/<short-kebab-slug>`, where type is a Conventional Commits type (feat, fix, refactor, perf, docs, test, build, ci, chore).

commitMessage.instructions: Conventional Commits: `<type>(<scope>): <summary>` in English, imperative, lowercase summary, no trailing period. Scope is the package name without `@nzyme/` (e.g. `feat(vue-forms): ...`); omit it for repo-wide changes. Mark breaking changes with `!` after the scope. Versions and the changelog are computed from these messages.

pullRequest.instructions: The title becomes the squash commit on main, so it must be a Conventional Commits message: `<type>(<scope>): <summary>`, scope = package name without `@nzyme/`, `!` for breaking changes. The body explains what changed and why, in English.
